newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end mixed, currency and politics weigh.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end mixed, currency and politics weigh.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index ended modestly higher on Wednesday but worries over the strength of sterling, rises in corporate taxes and possible interest rate hikes here and in the U.S. continued to weigh on sentiment.
The FTSE finished 7.8 points firmer at 4,294.6. A late surge in B.A.T Industries accounted for most of the rise.

UK stocks failed to hold on to the 4,300 level, recaptured at the start of trade on the back of Wall Street's biggest one-day gain for ten years. "Volumes are desperate," one dealer said. "People do not want to get involved in front of the election and in situations like this, one stock can make all the difference."
